Class JSIMModel

java.lang.Object
common.definitions.CommonModel
jsimwiz.definitions.JSIMModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
CommonConstants, BlockingRegionDefinition, ClassDefinition, SimulationDefinition, StationDefinition, EngineNodeConstants
public class JSIMModel extends CommonModel
Created by IntelliJ IDEA. User: orsotronIII Date: 25-lug-2005 Time: 14.31.58 This is a variant of CommonModel that automatically add source and sink stations to model as the first open class (if defined) is added to the model. If last open class is deleted, source and sink stations are deleted as well. This class is designed for a single-source and -sink model. Reference source for all open classes is this only source. Modified by Bertoli Marco 4-oct-2005 / Fixed bugs while loading from file
